items.title: Bitcoin's 'volatility curve' has a midterm bump
Bitcoin eases to $77,900 as Binance customers pull $3.6 billion after withdrawals reopen
items.summary: Bitcoin fell 0.4% to around $77,900 since midnight UTC as Binance customers pulled a net $3.64 billion after withdrawals reopened and ETFs lost $643 million.
